title: Unpacking the Ethical Value Alignment in Big Models
findings: Aligned models like GPT-4 and Bard scored lower on the 'sanctity' dimension, which requires a religious/cultural basis, compared to the unaligned LLaMA model. The paper suggests this is because dimensions like sanctity, loyalty, and authority have more diversity and ambiguity across cultures and social environments compared to care and fairness.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the ethical value tendencies of mainstream LLMs based on the five dimensions of the Moral Foundations Theory. One of these dimensions, 'Sanctity/Degradation', is explicitly linked to having a 'religious/cultural basis' for its moral judgments.
